excerpt: Estimate an Ajman apartment's market value by selecting comparable sales, adjusting for differences and recognising the limits of the evidence.
introduction:
An estimate of an Ajman apartment's market value is a reasoned range, not simply the seller's asking price or the amount paid several years ago. Start with recent completed transactions for similar units, then account for differences in building, size, condition, parking and terms. Where the decision is significant, obtain an appropriate professional valuation.

This guide explains a comparison method. The worked numbers show how comparable properties can be organised for a valuation discussion.
takeaways: Prefer recent completed sales of comparable units and distinguish them from advertised asking prices.
Adjust for meaningful differences and express uncertainty when evidence is thin.
Use an appropriately qualified valuer when the lender, authority or transaction requires a formal valuation.

sections.heading: What evidence should you collect?
sections.body:
Record the exact building and unit, net area and basis of measurement, bedrooms, floor, view, parking, condition, tenancy and any unusual rights or obligations. Search for recent completed transactions in the same building and similar projects where that evidence is available. Check the transaction date and whether the reported price includes furniture or other items.

Separate an asking price from a completed sale. A listing can be withdrawn, reduced or agreed on different terms; it is a useful view of competition but not proof of the price paid. Mortgage registrations, project valuations and total market transactions are also different measures from comparable apartment sales.

The [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026) provides context for the location, but it cannot replace evidence for the unit's building and condition.

Record whether a comparable apartment was vacant or tenanted, since possession terms can influence a buyer’s decision and price.

sections.heading: Adjust the comparables carefully
sections.body:
A larger apartment, allocated parking or a recently renovated kitchen may change what a buyer is willing to pay. A unit with significant repairs, an inconvenient layout or a lease that affects possession may require a different adjustment. The direction and size depend on actual evidence; avoid assigning a precise premium without support.

Use a consistent measurement basis. A price per square foot can help compare similar homes, but it can mislead if the reported areas include different balconies or common spaces. A per-unit comparison may be more appropriate when layouts and sizes are close.

Record both the adjustment and the reason. If only one old or weak comparable is available, widen the range and seek further evidence rather than presenting a single precise value.

sections.heading: Work through an example
sections.body:
Suppose three sample comparable sales are AED 500,000, AED 520,000 and AED 540,000. Their median is AED 520,000. If the subject apartment needs AED 20,000 of evidenced work and the comparison otherwise requires no adjustment, a simplified estimate might begin at AED 500,000. In practice, the cost of repair and the price effect are not necessarily identical.

The chart displays only the sample comparable prices. It is not data from Ajman, and a median alone is not a professional valuation. Check whether each comparable is genuinely similar, adjust other differences and express an appropriate range.

A buyer may also consider transaction charges and future repairs, but those are not automatically subtracted from a seller's market value in the same way in every transaction.

sections.heading: Read market statistics in context
sections.body:
Ajman's department, reported by [Emirates News Agency in October 2026](https://www.wam.ae/en/article/c2zjm1r-real-estate-valuation-transactions-ajman-reached), recorded 738 valuation transactions exceeding AED 3.31 billion in the third quarter. The report also identifies different property types and valuation purposes. These are valuations across a mix of properties, not completed sales of comparable apartments.

Such an aggregate can show activity in a broad period, but it does not establish a price per apartment, a growth rate for one building or the value of your unit. Check the definition and period before comparing any published figures.

Ajman's [real estate unit registration dataset](https://data.ajman.ae/explore/dataset/real-estate-units-registration/table/?flg=en-gb) describes initial and final registration transactions for development units. Examine its fields and coverage before using it; aggregate records may not supply the unit-level comparable details a valuation requires.

sections.heading: When should you request a professional valuation?
sections.body:
A lender or authority may require a valuation prepared for a specific purpose and date. Ask the requesting party which provider and report format it accepts. Even when not compulsory, independent advice can be useful where evidence is limited, the apartment is unusual or the financial decision is significant.

Give the valuer accurate documents, access to the apartment and information about the lease, condition and included parking. Ask about the report's assumptions, comparable evidence and valuation date. Do not treat a valuation for mortgage or another administrative purpose as an assurance of a future sale price.

Review the estimate if the property condition, market evidence or transaction terms change. A range becomes stale when its supporting evidence no longer reflects the decision date.

sections.heading: Use the estimate with current options
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Ajman project collection](/projects?emirate=Ajman) for local context, and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with the exact apartment and documents if you need a current market discussion. Ask for the source and date of any comparable evidence. Record whether each comparison is an asking price or a completed sale, and retain the unit details needed to understand its relevance. If the transaction details cannot be verified, give that comparison less weight and continue looking for stronger evidence.

Confirm the ownership position and obtain an appropriate professional report where the transaction or lender requires one. A project page or an advertised asking price is not a formal valuation.
